description: RFC 8621 §4.7: 'only mailboxIds, keywords, and receivedAt may be set during copy.' The handler extracts mailboxIds and keywords from the copy entry but never reads receivedAt. The backend copy_email() signature also has no receivedAt parameter (backend.rs line 523-532). A client that sets receivedAt in an Email/copy create entry will have the value silently discarded, resulting in the backend choosing a default received time instead.
title: Email/copy silently drops client-supplied receivedAt
